text: The layer mix shifts from 69 KDA linear attention plus 24 MLA (full) to 69 KDA linear attention plus 24 Gated DSA on MLA, and the sparse-attention token budget is 2,048 after being not stated for Kimi-K3. Total parameters go up from 2.7799T to 2.7801T, active parameters go up from 104.2B to 104.4B, and the growing cache per token goes up from 27 KB to 33 KB. For the weights, 5 weight groups were added with 179M parameters, and none were removed.
